researchSummary.finding: A bike hire operation has traded from Beddgelert Forest under the 'Beddgelert Bikes' brand for many years, but the original domain (beddgelertbikes.co.uk) has lapsed and the business appears to have been rebranded as '1085 Adventures' circa 2020–2021. The TripAdvisor listing for this combined entity is flagged as 'reported permanently closed', yet multiple other directories (YHA, Forest Holidays, MBWales, Iguanagogo, Visit Snowdonia) continue to list an active bike hire operation at this location. Sufficient factual data exists to draft a directory listing, but the current operational status and the correct trading name both require human verification before publication.
researchSummary.identityNote: Two overlapping entities: (A) 'Beddgelert Bikes / The Bike Barn' — the original long-running brand, domain now parked; (B) '1085 Adventures' — successor brand from ~2020, operator Nik Joyce/Paul Inch, same physical location. The Facebook page at facebook.com/beddgelertbike/ now presents as '1085 Adventures - Bike Hire Beddgelert'. The directory listing slug 'beddgelert-bikes' maps to the original brand; a redirect or merge with a '1085-adventures' slug may be needed. HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED.

description.full: Beddgelert Bikes (also trading as 1085 Adventures) is a cycle hire operation based in Beddgelert Forest, within Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park, North Wales. The hire centre sits approximately two miles from Beddgelert village, accessed via the A4085 Caernarfon–Beddgelert road and signposted into the forest. Visitors can hire mountain bikes, e-bikes, children's bikes, tandems, tag-alongs, child seats, and trailers, with helmets, locks, repair kits, and trail maps included. The forest provides direct access to two waymarked NRW trails — the 4 km Bedwen Trail (family-level) and the 9.5 km Derwen Trail — as well as the Lon Gwyrfai, a traffic-free 4-mile off-road cycleway linking Beddgelert to Rhyd Ddu along the Afon Colwyn, running parallel to the Welsh Highland Railway. Drop-off services, group bookings, and long-term hire are available. The location sits south of Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon), close to the Aberglaslyn Gorge and Llyn Dinas.
